verdict.rationale: Evidence shows CAM is India-focused with related practice pages (PE/venture capital, investment funds, fintech, DPDP privacy law) but no ESOP-specific content (explicitly noted as 'No ESOP-specific page cached') and no coverage of UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, or French BSPCE despite having Singapore and Abu Dhabi offices. Missing for 10: dedicated FDI/ESOP instrument guidance, and any UK/German/French jurisdiction-specific startup instrument publications.
